description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) called LeaveRequestCommentSearchFilterParams, which extends DateRangeSearchFilterParams to include filtering options for leave request comments, specifically including a leave request ID and sort field configuration.

classes.name: LeaveRequestCommentSearchFilterParams
classes.description: DTO for filtering leave request comments with date range and leave request ID, extends DateRangeSearchFilterParams.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object and sets default sort field to 'leaveRequestComment.createdAt'.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestId
methods.description: Returns the leave request ID filter value.

methods.name: setLeaveRequestId
methods.description: Sets the leave request ID filter value.
